units.source_text: 我很庆幸自己收藏了一本长崎耶稣会刊，里面写到：《列干达·奥乌里亚》，

en.t: I am glad that I own a Nagasaki Jesuit publication, in which it is written, Legenda Aurea,
which is a phonetic rendering of LEGENDA AUREA.

units.source_text: 内容虽然不是全部像西欧的“黄金传说”，然而对于记载彼士使徒圣者的言行而外，

en.t: Although its contents are not entirely like the Western Golden Legend, besides recording the words and deeds of Saint Peter the Apostle,

units.source_text: 也采录本地西教徒猛志精进的事迹，是福音传道书中的一种。

en.t: it also includes accounts of local Christians who pursued their faith with fierce resolve, and is one kind of Gospel missionary writing.
